description: The plot illustrates training loss with respect to training steps for different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10000, with tick labels at intervals of 1000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are five lines displayed. The first line, representing “Vanilla”, is green and solid, starting at a loss of approximately 1.38 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.12 at step 10000. The second line, representing “Sep1.1M (n=256)”, is red and dashed, starting at a loss of approximately 1.38 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.13 at step 10000. The third line, representing “Sep1.1M (n=64)”, is orange and dotted, starting at a loss of approximately 1.38 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.14 at step 10000. The fourth line, representing “Sep8.1M (n=64)”, is purple and dash-dotted, starting at a loss of approximately 1.38 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.15 at step 10000. The fifth line, representing “Sep8.1M (n=256)”, is teal and solid, starting at a loss of approximately 1.38 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.13 at step 10000.
